How a line works: word, then thing, then key=value settings, then free words: set dk74 at=40,40 · post "two words" · window.open feed to=left. A thing is named by its id (dk74, shown in every answer; rows <kind> lists them). A receipt [r812] names a record; undo r812 takes it back. ; separates two lines, and a do line that runs several steps is still one act, one undo. see words read (they never change anything); do words act; hear words are things that happen (rules listen for them).
